public class PartStateItem<P extends org.cyclops.integrateddynamics.api.part.write.IPartTypeWriter> extends PartStatePositionedAddon<P, IItemNetwork, net.minecraft.world.item.ItemStack> implements net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.ResourceHandler<net.neoforged.neoforge.transfer.item.ItemResource>
A part state for handling item import and export. It also acts as an item capability that can be added to itself.
